content: Phawuloosi Melaaxiya biittan
Nu Biittay dizaso sarotethan gakkidappe guye nu gakkida abba giddon diza derey Melaaxiya geetettiza dere gididaro eridos.
He dereyin diza asay daro malalisiza kiyateth nuus ooththides. He wode iray bukkida gishshinne meeggo gidida gish tama eththidi nuna mokki ekkida.
Phawuloosi afira giza mithi shiishshidi taman gujin tama seelappe dendidayssan shooshi kezidi iza kushe bolla xaaxxetides.

Malta asay shooshi Phawuloosa kushe bolla xaaxxetidayssa beyidi “Hayssi addezi shempo wodhidade; gaasoyka abba dambalappekka izi attidi yikkokka pirdiza Xoossafe kessi ekkidi paxa daana dandaybenna” giidi ba giddon haasayettida
Phawuloosi qas shoosha duge taman qoqof yeggidi aykkokka hanibenna.

Asaykka “Aydeppe ayde iza asatethay kixxanesha; woykko qopponta kundidi hayqqana” giidi naagides; gido attin isti daro wode naagishin iza bolla aykkoynne hanontayssa beyidi ba qofa lammidi “Hayssi addezi xoossa!” gides.
He nu dizaso matan abba giddon diza dereyo ayssiza Puppulyoosa geetettizades gadey dees; he addezi nuna mokki ekkidi bason heedzdzu gallas gakkanaas lo7ethi imattides.
Heen Puppulyoosa aawa miishaynne guso hargey sakkin ichchidi dees; Phawuloosi izakko gelidi izas woossidessinne iza bolla ba kushe woththidi pathides.
Hessi hessatho hanidappe guye he dereyn diza hara harganchati yiidi paxida.
Asaykka nuus daro miish ehidi nuna bonchizayssa nuna bessida; nu markaben baana dendin nuus koshshizayssa markaben wursi caanida.
Phawuloosi Milixineppe Oroome bides

Nu Milixinen heedzdzu agina gam7idappe guye balgoy aadhdhana gakkanaas abba giddon diza dereyin gam7idi Iskindiriyappe yiza markaben gelidi baana dendidos; he markabeza bolla Diyossiqoroosa geetettiza nam7u mente eeqata misiley dees.
Gede Sirakuuse geetettiza katama gakkidi heen heedzdzu gallas gam7idos.
Heeppe abba bollara biidi Regiyoome geetettiza katama gakkidos; heen issi gallas aqidi duge baggara yiza carkoy carkida gish nam7antho gallas Puttiyoloose geetettizaso bidos.
Heen ammanizayta demmidi istara nu laapun gallas gakkanaas uttana mala nuna woossida. Heeppe qasse Oroome bidos.
Oroomen diza ammaniza asay nu gish siydi Apiyoose geetettiza giyanne “Heedzdzu Aqosota” geetettizaso gakkanaas nuna mokkana yida; Phawuloosaykka ista beyidi Xoosse galatidessinne minetides.
Phawuloosi Oroomen
Nuni Oroome gelida wode Phawuloosa naaganas issi wotadaray izas imettin Phawuloosi barka daana mala izas fiiqadey imettides.

Heedzdzu gallassafe guye Phawuloosi Oroomen diza Ayhudatappe gita asata baako xeygisides; istika izakko shiiqin “Ta ishato! Tani Isra7eele dere bollanne nu aawata woga bolla ooththida issi qohoykka deenna; gido attin Yerusalamen tana qachidi Oroome asatas aaththi immida.
Oroome asati tana qori oychidappe guye tana hayqos gaththiza miish demmoonta aggida gish birshi yeddana koyda.
Gido attin Ayhuda asay ta bolla issi wosoy baynda yeddetonta mala eqqettin ta yo7oy Qeesare sinth shiiqidi beetto gaanas taas gidde gidides. Gido attin tani ta dereta mootiza gaasoy taas deenna.
Ta qas ha7i intena xeygisiday intena beyanassinne hanno intes yootanassa. Hayssa sansalatan tani qashetiday Isra7eele naytas imettida ufaysa gaasonna” gides.
Istika izas “Ne gish Yuhuda dereppe xaafetida debiddabbey nuna gakkibeenna. Ha yida asatappe oonikka ne gish iita haasayiday baawa.
Hayssa ne kaalliza ammanoza gish awanka asay iita haasayizayssa nu eroos. Hessa gish ne qofay azakkonne nu siyana koyoos” gi zaarida.

Bare izas immidi hara gallas kushe kumidi izi diza keeththe yida. Izikka maladoppe omars gakkanaas Xoossa Kawoteththa gish markatethan ba qofa istas qoncisides. Muse wogappenne nabeta maxaafatappe xaqasi xaqasi Yesusa gish istas qoncisi yootides.
Istafe issi issi asati izi yootida qaala ammanida; baggayti qas ammanibetenna.
Istika ba giddon issoy issara qofan gaggonta shaaketida; Phawuloosi wursethan yootishe “Xillo Ayanay nabe Isayaasa baggara kase inte aawatas yootidayssi tumakko!
Izi yootida qaalay,

content.text: ‘Hayssa derakko baada inte sisi siyana shin yuushi qoppeketa,
ayfera beyana shin woznan wotheketa gaada yoota.
ba haythara siydi ba woznan yuushi qoppidi

content: “Histikko Xoossi as ashshiza kiitay Ayzaabetaska kiitettidayssa inte erite; istika ero giidi ekkettes” gides.
Phawuloosi hessa yootidappe guye Ayhuda asati ba giddon daro palametishe kezi bida.
Phawuloosi kiratida keeththan nam7u layth kumeth de7ides; baako yiza as wursi mokki ekkides.
Xoossa kawoteth sabakon Goda Yesus Kirstoosa gish oonikka iza diggonta xalatethara asa tamarsides.

Issi issi Geeshsha Maxaafatan paydo 29 bolla diza qofay gujettibenna.
